summary:
Comprehensive deep analysis report of the SGOU Academic Database platform covering 10 sections:

1. Executive scorecard with health ratings across 10 dimensions
2. 5 CRITICAL issues (broken viewer, broken reader, no offline state, CSP weakness, admin auth)
3. 7 HIGH-PRIORITY issues (DOM overload, no skeletons, mobile UX gaps, no continue reading, no autocomplete, no onboarding, no favorites page)
4. 6 UI/UX optimization recommendations (card info density, dark mode contrast, AI discoverability, trust signals, freshness badges, line length)
5. 8 features to add (study planner, bookmarks, WhatsApp sharing, study streaks, Malayalam UI, download queue, notifications, screen reader fixes)
6. 6 things to remove/restructure (scratch dir, playwright artifacts, data consolidation, CSS split, SEO cleanup, raw images)
7. Native-app parity gap analysis with effort estimates
8. User-friendliness honest assessment for rural Kerala students
9. 4-phase prioritized action plan with timelines
10. Architecture evolution recommendations
